PublisherFindings.CodecBehavior: SSView searches its own directory for DLLs exporting EncodeIStream and DecodeIStream; selected decoders are used to view streams, and selected encoders/decoders participate in stream save/load. The ZLIB codec is identified as a sample included in the distribution.
PublisherFindings.GenericTrialTerms: Trial or unregistered software is freeware for non-commercial use; the EULA provides evaluation-only trial terms and nontransferable named-user/build-machine, team and site license types.
PublisherFindings.SoftwareDistribution: The software EULA permits one backup/archive copy and prohibits transfer of license rights without written permission. No separate redistribution grant for the product archive was found.
PublisherFindings.SampleSourceRights: The ZLIB codec is described as sample Delphi source, but no explicit license or attribution terms for ZLibCodec.dpr/ZLibCodec.dll are stated on the current product page or identified in the retained archive review.
PublisherFindings.SampleFileRights: The current product page does not identify ownership or terms for test.ss.

RetainedEvidence.KnownStaticRisk: On codec exception the reviewed sample may return partial output followed by original bytes; build/runtime behavior remains unverified.
